subject: A woman in her fifties in a brick-red and indigo checked Kandangi cotton sari, kneeling to draw a pulli kolam in white rice flour on the courtyard floor, jasmine strung in her hair, a brass kuthuvilakku lamp lit beside her

setting.place: Courtyard (mutram) of a Chettiar mansion in Kanadukathan, Chettinad, Sivaganga district, Tamil Nadu, with Burma teak pillars, carved teak doors, and a floor of handmade Athangudi cement tiles in terracotta and ochre
setting.era: 1930s, the heyday of the Nattukottai Chettiar mansions
setting.time_of_day: golden hour, late afternoon in mid-December, low warm sun raking across the courtyard

lighting: soft cool blue pre-dawn light from the open sky above the courtyard, warm flicker from the brass lamp, light mist hanging low

camera.angle: eye level, slightly low, looking across the courtyard through the pillars

style: natural documentary photography, muted film tones, realistic skin and fabric texture
avoid: generic sari or heavy bridal jewellery
